ExercisecomTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create a Personal API Token in Exercise.com and paste it here. It acts as the platform owner, so use only an account authorized for these operations. Choose your API host; the published contract also exposes the demo and staging hosts. Connection checks list staff tasks and require task access. NoClick does not request your password or create a session.
